shortDescription: Review delivery claims against a frozen handoff promise, attested evidence, two-party challenges and semantic consensus.
detailedDescription: ParcelCourt is a full GenLayer application for a delivery claim lifecycle. Creator and recipient consent before freezing the handoff promise; a separate attestor wallet commits to the evidence digest and source reference. The browser reads a canonical paged case registry and hash-linked semantic history and supports case actions, challenges, re-adjudication and finalization.
problemSolved: Delivery disputes depend on natural-language handoff promises and evidence that may be incomplete, manipulated or contradictory.
whyGenLayer: Validators independently evaluate delivery claims against the exact frozen promise and evidence. A conventional deterministic workflow cannot decide whether a handoff record substantively satisfies that promise.
semanticConsensus: Validators independently classify handoff_matches_promise, authorized_recipient_supported and evidence_sufficient. Strict vector validation and a bounded deterministic verdict prevent model output from selecting actors, parameters, deadlines or money. The second round includes challenge text; one party cannot take the other party’s response slot.
reviewInstructions: Inspect production URL in read-only mode, the deployed contract, and evidence/parcelcourt-live.json for GLV4-parcelcourt-39138804500. The terminal verdict is UNRESOLVED. The current public frontend remains RELEASE_QUALIFIED=false; updated source has not yet been deployed pending signed-browser qualification.
knownLimitations: Attestor signing proves agreed-wallet control, not carrier identity, physical delivery or document authenticity. No external carrier identity oracle or asset settlement exists. Live qualification records were synthetic. The updated repository frontend has not been deployed to the public URL.
